size_reason: Turn-end refuse-hook on a north-star or captain.md citation without a this-session last-AMENDED read receipt. Widen the landed owner-invoke helper as a sibling rule. Full adversary rounds are a later ship if the light refuse is trusted.
shape: A captain-facing product rec cites a north-star or captain.md pointer without a same-session last-AMENDED read receipt.
structure: bin/fm-owner-invoke-wait-check.sh R-cached-north-star on current-turn assistant_text tokens north star, north-star, or captain.md, plus turn.amended_receipt gathered from state/.amended-opened path= and session= matching state/.lock. Does not judge whether the rec is wise.
instances: 0DTE deferred from an old planning-map reading against the captain levels-you-can-act-on statement.
Library tip was treated as current while the chart instance was stale.

fixture_source.derivation: reconstruct the cached-pointer sitting as current-turn citation tokens plus a missing amended_receipt string, not as a wisdom parse of the rec

ci_gate: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs bin/fm-test-run.sh --check-coverage and all portable lanes; the test inventory includes tests/fm-owner-invoke-wait-check.test.sh and tests/fm-turnend-guard.test.sh
limits: A name-only captain.md mention still requires a receipt.
Opening an AMENDED file without writing state/.amended-opened is no receipt.
The receipt path is not proven to be the last AMENDED lock.
Product recs that never cite those tokens are invisible.
skipped: Adversarial rounds because size is light: one fresh reader via the test suite is enough.
Merging this class into R-owner-invoke-deliverable or R-owner-invoke-wait.
Parsing whether the rec is wise.
